lore_anchors.definition: In Xianxia, this is a score of cosmic goodwill. It manifests as a visible aura/golden light around the cultivator and improves luck, helps stabilize a sect's fortune, and makes tribulations easier to endure.

A supreme defensive divine ability in the Three Realms. Trained through nine cycles of body refinement, it renders the user's body as indestructible as a magic treasure without consuming any divine power to maintain that state.

One of the top-ten divine abilities in the Three Realms. Based on the legendary archer Houyi's techniques, it allows a cultivator to shoot a lethal arrow from a distance of a hundred thousand li or more.

The coalesced form of the Primal Daoist's soul and power. The tortoise represents the foundation of Yin, while the serpent represents the movement of Yang. Their union is a prerequisite for birthing the Earth Immortal's golden lotus.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't Ji Ning choose more divine abilities?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He applied the core Daoist principle of 'specialization.' Mastering a few core abilities (Starseizing Hand, Eight-Nine Arcane Art, Houyi Archery) is far more valuable than having a hundred shallowly-trained gimmicks.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is 'Planting the Golden Lotus in Flames'?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's the process of the Primaltwin's breakthrough from Primal to Earth Immortal. The Tortoise-Serpent Primal provides the soil (energy foundation), the Primordial Fire provides the sunlight (refining heat), and the golden lotus sprouts as the new, purer vessel for the soul.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ning stop at late-stage Earth Immortal?
cultural_notes_faq.a: If he reached the peak of the Earth Immortal stage, his Heavenly Tribulation could descend at any time. He is saving that massive risk for a more controlled situation, focusing on combat preparation first.
